appearance_facts.fact: A single blue line with circular markers connects data points from 2006 to 2018.
The data point for 2010 is located at approximately y=8.1 on the 'Count' axis.
The data point for 2018 is located at approximately y=7.6 on the 'Count' axis.

public_definitions: Review the annual mortality surveillance dashboard and route the year that should receive peak-burden follow-up.
Use the yearly mortality trend in the chart to determine which reporting year warrants escalation, then select the corresponding routing option.
